name: design-qa
description: Gate a UI before it is called done: check the build, not the design file. Three deterministic stdlib scripts: a finish linter that blocks on controls that do nothing, dead links, placeholder copy and removed focus rings, and warns on template defaults; an interaction-state checker that derives loading, empty, error, busy and focus states from each surface's kind and blocks when they are missing or unevidenced; and a rendered audit that reads a browser snapshot and blocks on WCAG 2.2 AA failures in contrast, focus visibility, focus obscured, reflow at 320 px, accessible names and target size. Ships a read-only snapshot collector, an optional Playwright keyboard pass, cs-design-qa agent, /cs-design-qa and /cs-ui-finish-lint commands, 3 cited references and a finish sign-off.
